question: How does the survivor count |C_t|(t) vary across the full LC, and are the sharpest anchors confined to bright peaks?
hypothesis: Sharp anchors are not bright-peak-only; the dimmest LC moments can be the sharpest.
narrative_md: Full-LC |C_t|(t) scan (N=25k Sobol, TOL=0.10 mag) on seeds 28/89/10 shows survivor counts vary 20-300x across the LC, with sharp anchors split between bright and dim extremes and never in mid-mag. On seed 28 the single sharpest moment (|C_t|=5) is the dimmest LC point (t=312, 76x sharper than the s059j early-window argmin). Confirms sharpness is not brightness; anchor selection must scan the full LC. K=4 cluster-independent anchors exist on seeds 28 and 89; seed 10 has only 3.
